jobs.title: AI & Data - AI Lab: Full-Stack Engineer - Agentic AI Platform - Manager
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

General Information

Location:
Ireland - Dublin

Available for Work Visa Sponsorship:
No

Business Area:
AI & Data

EY exists to build a better working world, we empower our people by offering the culture, tech, teams, scale, challenges, learning, and the relationships for you to personalise and build your career, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

The Team and the opportunity

Join EY’s AI Lab, part of our innovation hub for EY Ireland .
The AI Lab is where cutting-edge ideas meet real-world impact. We focus on developing advanced AI solutions, experimenting with emerging technologies, and creating prototypes that push the boundaries of what’s possible.

As part of this team, you’ll:

Collaborate with experts in data science, machine learning, and engineering to design and deliver transformative AI solutions.
Work on pioneering projects that explore generative AI, predictive analytics, and intelligent automation.
Shape the future of business by turning research into scalable solutions for global clients.
Innovate in a dynamic environment, where creativity and experimentation are encouraged.

This is more than a role—it’s an opportunity to be part of a team that is redefining how organizations harness AI to solve complex challenges. If you’re passionate about innovation and want to work at the forefront of AI technology, the AI Lab is the place for you.

Your Key Responsibilities

Design, develop and maintain full-stack web applications supporting agentic AI workflows.
Build cloud-native microservices and APIs (FastAPI, Node.js, Python) integrating LLM and RAG components.
Develop responsive front-ends using React and Power Apps to provide intuitive user experiences.
Implement CI/CD pipelines, containerisation (Docker/Kubernetes), and monitoring for performance and reliability.
Collaborate cross-functionally to integrate Azure OpenAI, LangChain/LangGraph, and Power Automate flows into the platform.
Contribute to engineering standards, code reviews and reusable AI Lab components.

To qualify for the role, you must have

5-7 + years’ experience delivering full-stack applications in production.
Proficiency in React (or Angular/Vue), Node.js and Python frameworks.
Experience building APIs (REST / GraphQL) and deploying on Azure or AWS using containerisation and serverless patterns.
Familiarity with SQL/NoSQL databases and data pipeline integration.
Understanding of LLM integration, prompt engineering, and AI API consumption.

Ideally, you will also have

Experience with LangChain/LangGraph, RAG pipelines and agentic architectures.
Familiarity with Power Platform (Power Apps / Power Automate) and workflow automation.
Strong DevOps skills and testing automation mindset

What Working At EY Offers

We offer a competitive remuneration package. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:

Support and coaching from some of the most engaging colleagues around
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

All our employees are given a benefits package which they can tailor to suit their individual preferences. Our range of benefits include:

Pension
Discounted health insurance
Web Doctor - Free unlimited online GP consultations for you and your family
The purchase of additional annual leave
Hybrid Working
Free Gym membership
Travel Pass
Maternity & Paternity leave
Bike to work Scheme
Recognition Awards
Cash incentives for referrals
Work Mobile
TECH MBA paid by EY
Wellness rooms Available in some offices

EY is committed to being an inclusive employer and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities. While our client-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance.

Career Progression

When you join EY, you will be supported to ensure that you are enhancing your skills from day one.
Continuous learning, where you can develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
As you grow and develop here, you’ll discover opportunities to help customise your career journey, so that it’s as unique as you are - success is defined by you, we will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership, we will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture, you will be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
We have embraced Hybrid working at EY adding greater flexibility and autonomy to the roles of our employees.

About EY

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we’re using the finance products, expertise and systems we’ve developed to build a better working world. That starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom to make things better. Whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.

Inclusion & Diversity

We hold a collective commitment to foster an environment where all differences are valued and respected, practices are equitable and everyone experiences a sense of belonging: Inclusion, diversity, and equity are part of who we are at EY. We believe that the highest-performing teams maximize the power of different perspectives and backgrounds. These teams are both diverse and inclusive and are willing to invite and learn from other perspectives. Our ability to include various viewpoints into our mindsets, behaviours and operations is fundamental to driving innovation, building strong relationships, and delivering the best solutions for our clients.

We recognise the strength that comes from having a diverse workforce and building a culture where we support all our people to achieve their potential. You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

As an equal opportunities’ employer, we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. Reasonable accommodations are offered at every stage of our recruitment process.

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

IMPORTANT: Where Agency assistance is required, our Talent Team will engage directly with suppliers. CVs / Profiles should not be shared directly with Hiring Managers. Unsolicited CVs / Profiles supplied to EY by Recruitment Agencies will not be accepted for this role

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

jobs.title: Cloud Support Associate Internship - April 2027 start, Support Engineering
jobs.description:
Description

**This is a 6 month internship starting in April 2027**

We’re on the lookout for the curious, those who think big and want to define the world of tomorrow. At Amazon, you will grow into the high impact, visionary person you know you’re ready to be. Every day will be filled with exciting new challenges, developing new skills, and achieving personal growth.

How often can you say that your work changes the world? At Amazon, you’ll say it often. Join us and define tomorrow.

Would you like to use the latest cloud computing technologies? Do you have an interest in helping customers understand application architectures and integration approaches? Are you familiar with best practices for applications, servers, and networks? Do you want to be part of a customer facing technology team helping to ensure the success of AWS as a leading technology organization? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the market leader and technology forerunner in the cloud business. As a member of the AWS support team you will be at the forefront of this transformational technology, assisting a global list of companies and developers that are taking advantage of a growing set of services and features to run their mission-critical applications.

As an Amazon intern, you will be interacting with your peers and the AWS global team of full-time professionals as part of our AWS Cloud Support team. You will benefit from the opportunity to gain experience on our cloud services, hands on training, and learning as you go.

If you fit the description, you could be the person we are looking for. We are a group of smart people, passionate about cloud computing, and believe that world-class support is critical to customer success.

Come build the future with us.

Key job responsibilities

Each day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:

Learn and use ground-breaking technologies.
Complete AWS certifications.
Work on projects that improve support-related processes with fellow interns in other locations.
Design, build and deploy tools/applications for AWS Support Engineers.
Interact with leading engineers around the world.
Partner with AWS teams.

A day in the life

Why us?

The Cloud Support Associate Internship Program provides interns with the technical and functional skills training based on Cloud Support Builder standards.
On a typical day, a Cloud Support Builder will be primarily responsible for solving customer’s cases through customer contact channels (e.g., telephone, email, and web/live chat). They apply troubleshooting techniques to provide solutions for our customers by thoughtfully working with customers to dive deep into the root cause of an issue.
A Cloud Support Builder may also develop, train, partner with development teams on complex issues or contact deflection initiatives, participate in new hiring, write tools/script to help the team, or work with leadership on process improvement and strategic initiatives.

About The Team

If you’re insatiably curious and always want to learn more, then you’ve come to the right place. Depending on your location, country, job status and other requirements, some or all of the following benefits may be available to you as an intern.

Competitive pay
Impactful project and internship/role deliverables
Networking opportunities with fellow interns
Internships events such as speaker series, intern panels, Leadership Principles sessions, Amazon writing skills sessions.
Mentorship and career development

The internship is a fixed term program, the start date will be April 2027 for a duration of 6 months.

We are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, and leveraging our unique perspectives to scale our impact and grow. Amazon has 13 affinity groups (https://www.aboutamazon.com/affinity-groups), sometimes known as employee resource groups, which bring employees together across businesses and locations around the world. With executive and company sponsorship, these groups play an important role in building internal networks for creating a community, advising Amazon business units, leading in service projects, and reaching out to communities where Amazonians live and work.

If you have a disability and need an adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please contact the Applicant-Candidate Accommodation Team (ACAT): https://www.amazon.jobs/en/disability/uk

Basic Qualifications

Currently enrolled in or will receive a Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Tech with a graduation date in 2028
Basic knowledge of at least one functional scripting language (e.g., Perl, Python, Ruby, shell scripting).
Basic knowledge of Networking and Databases.
Basic knowledge of Operation Systems Windows and/or Linux.

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of internet fundamentals and cloud computing concepts.
Familiarity with Database, Storage, & Big Data concepts.
Knowledge of Networking fundamentals like CIDR notations, OSI model, DNS, HTTP, TCP/UDP, DHCP, routing, switching, subnets, NAT.
Comfortable working in a Linux/Unix environment.
Customer facing work experience.

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Senior System Developer
jobs.description:
Vi ser etter en kreativ og nysgjerrig seniorutvikler
som vil utvikle systemintegrasjoner og automatisering for KSAT. Sammen med teamet bygger du løsninger som oppdager feil, setter hendelser i sammenheng og automatiserer feilretting.

Du vil jobbe i et tverrfaglig team tett på operasjonsmiljøene våre. Arbeidet omfatter blant annet drivere, scrapere, monitorering og integrasjoner mellom tekniske systemer og hendelseshåndtering. Vi skal gjøre komplekse driftsdata om til nyttig informasjon og konkrete handlinger.

Som seniorutvikler får du bidra til tekniske veivalg og utvikle skalerbare, standardiserte og gjenbrukbare løsninger. Vi ønsker også at du deler kunnskap og bidrar til å gjøre teamet bedre. Arbeidssted kan være enten Oslo eller Tromsø.

Dette vil du jobbe med

Bryte ned komplekse behov til konkrete, gjennomførbare utviklingsoppgaver.
Utvikle integrasjoner for innsamling, bearbeiding og tilgjengeliggjøring av data.
Utvikle regler og algoritmer som oppdager avvik, korrelerer hendelser og støtter identifisering av rotårsaker.
Samle og berike alarmer før de sendes videre til systemet for hendelseshåndtering.
Utvikle automatisert feilretting med tydelige kontrollmekanismer.
Bidra til arkitektur, kodekvalitet og felles utviklingspraksis.

Vi ser etter deg som har

Solid erfaring med systemutvikling og kompetanse innen relevante teknologier, som Rust, C# eller React.
Erfaring med Docker, Kubernetes og skymiljøer, samt god forståelse av nettverk.
Erfaring med databaser, datasett og behandling av data fra ulike kilder.
Kunnskap om dataanalyse og erfaring med å finne mønstre og korrelasjoner i logger, måledata eller hendelser. Du forstår forskjellen mellom korrelasjon og årsakssammenheng.
Erfaring med agentisk utvikling, der KI-agenter brukes til å planlegge, implementere, teste og forbedre kode, med kritisk vurdering og kvalitetssikring av resultatene.
Evne til å skrive god, lesbar og vedlikeholdbar kode som i stor grad dokumenterer seg selv, og dokumentere arkitektur og viktige tekniske beslutninger.
Gode problemløsningsferdigheter og evne til å forstå både detaljene og systemet som helhet.
Evne til å samarbeide tett med utviklere, operasjonsteam og andre fagmiljøer for å løse reelle brukerbehov.

Kjennskap til tjenesteleveranse og hendelseshåndtering etter ITIL-rammeverket er en fordel.

Du trenger ikke kunne alt

Kjenner du deg igjen i omtrent 70 prosent av det vi beskriver? Da oppfordrer vi deg til å søke. Vi verdsetter solid utviklerkompetanse, nysgjerrighet og vilje til å lære, og forventer ikke at du har erfaring med alle teknologiene vi bruker.

KSAT - A Stellar Workplace

Vi er en organisasjon i stor vekst og med solid økonomi. I KSAT møter du et aktivt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø og vi ønsker noen som vil bygge videre på dette. Hos oss får du dyktige og engasjerte kolleger, en fleksibel og variert hverdag, fantastiske utviklingsmuligheter og en unik mulighet til å være med på å utvikle en spennende fremtid for KSAT.

Om ikke dette var nok, så tilbyr vi også blant annet:

Konkurransedyktige lønnsbetingelser, kursing, treningsrom på arbeidsplassen, svært gode helseforsikringer og pensjonsordninger, telefon og mobilabonnement, firmahytte, støtte til idrett m.m.
Vi er en sosial gjeng som gjør ting utenfor jobb, både i regi av bedriften og på privat initiativ. Her blir du inkludert fra dag én.
Et miljø du garantert vil lære av - uansett kompetansenivå i dag. Du kommer til et miljø med høy kompetanse og med et sterkt ønske og vilje til å levere kvalitet i verdensklasse - i alle ledd i organisasjonen

Du kan bli bedre kjent med oss gjennom SPACE UP YOUR CAREER https://karriere.ksat.no/ . Her vil du se hvordan vi jobber samt få muligheten til å bli kjent med mange av de fine folkene i KSAT.

KSAT legger vekt på å sikre mangfold i bedriften ved å ta hensyn til kjønn, alder og kulturell bakgrunn under rekrutteringen.

Stillingen kan kreve at man oppfyller vilkår for norsk sikkerhetsklarering, samt kunne autoriseres og være skikket til stillingen. Sluttkandidater vil måtte gjennomføre en bakgrunnssjekk av Semac.

Søknader vil bli vurdert fortløpende - så send gjerne inn en søknad i dag!

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about building software that powers real-world manufacturing and drives the digital transformation of global production?
Then join our mission to pioneer smarter water solutions that reduce energy use and improve lives.

As our new Full-Stack Software Developer
, you'll be designing, developing, and maintaining full-stack applications for Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) that support critical production processes across Grundfos's global manufacturing sites. You'll be part of a diverse, supportive and inclusive culture, that celebrates our differences and puts people first by fostering growth, well-being, and a sense of belonging.

What you will be doing

As a key part of the Manufacturing IT team, you'll create impact by building scalable, integrated software solutions that connect enterprise systems with shop-floor operations, enabling smarter and more efficient production worldwide.

Your main responsibilities include:

Design, develop, and deploy full-stack applications using .NET, C#, React, and MS SQL on local servers or Azure Cloud services
Build APIs and backend services for system integration, including SAP and shop-floor automation equipment using industrial protocols such as OPC UA
Collaborate with production engineering, IT, and infrastructure stakeholders to translate business needs into reliable, maintainable software solutions
Maintain and enhance CI/CD pipelines and automation scripts for build, test, and deployment workflows
Ensure code quality through peer reviews, unit/integration testing, and adherence to coding standards within an agile SCRUM team
Provide mentorship and technical guidance to associate developers while contributing to architectural discussions and continuous improvement

What makes you a great fit

Above all, you're a skilled full-stack developer with strong .NET and React experience, a solid grasp of system integration patterns, and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical peers and domain experts in a fast-paced agile environment.

We'd also imagine that you are/have:

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
3+ years of full-stack development experience with .NET, C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, and MS SQL
Solid understanding of software engineering principles and patterns (e.g., SOLID), RESTful APIs, and web application frameworks
Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and scripting (e.g., PowerShell)

It's a plus if you also:

Experience with Siemens Opcenter Discrete MES platform development and configuration
Familiarity with ERP systems (especially SAP) and/or shop-floor integration using industrial protocols (OPC UA, MQTT)
Experience with Azure Cloud services and containerized deployments

Why you'll love working here

Day to day, you can look forward to:

A working environment built around your needs, with flexible hours, home working opportunities and parental support.
Annual bonuses, health insurance and a strong focus on well-being activities.
Three days' additional paid leave for volunteering.
On-demand training and structured development programmes to support your growth.

Valuing our differences helps us see possibilities where others can't. We therefore welcome and encourage applications from all abilities, experiences, and backgrounds. As part of our commitment to a safe and compliant hiring process, final candidates may be required to undergo a background check, subject to applicable local laws and regulations.

Join Grundfos, apply today!

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (C#/.NET/Python)
jobs.location: Billund, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Job Description

Are you a wizard with C#/.NET and Python?

Then we're looking for YOU!

The Play Software department at the LEGO Group focuses on enabling engaging and seamless digital experiences by developing innovative software tools and platforms. The Senior Software Engineer role supports this by delivering high-quality software solutions that empower developers to build interactive LEGO experiences efficiently.

Responsibilities

Develop and maintain modular, testable, deployable, and easy-to-maintain software solutions for interactive LEGO products using a mix of C# .NET, AvaloniaUI, and Python to name a few.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to create tools that support developers in creating tech-enabled LEGO experiences, considering developer experience.
Ensure high software quality through code reviews, automated testing, and continuous integration, with a strong emphasis on unit testing, while being comfortable with context switching between projects.
Support the automation of pipelines and toolchain development to improve developer efficiency and quality of life, balancing between perfecting software and making rapid delivery.
Engage in architectural discussions to drive innovation and technical excellence, making loosely coupled IT solutions.
Mentor junior engineers, providing technical guidance and best practices, and fostering an environment eager to teach, learn, and experiment with an agile mindset.
Embrace the "You build it, you run it, you own it" philosophy, ensuring ownership and accountability for the software developed.

Requirements

Comfortable with C and C++ to a level that they can navigate codebases in these languages.
Experience in software development with C# .NET, with a proven ability to optimize software for performance and scalability.
Ability to engage in architectural discussions to drive innovation and technical excellence, seeing the red line across a tool portfolio and putting it into a system.
Experience with Git and Git actions, and a strong understanding of security and data privacy.
Demonstrated experience in automating development pipelines and improving developer toolchains, with knowledge of Docker.
Comfortable working with cloud endpoints and backend integration.

Nice to have

Understanding of DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines.
Proficiency in scripting languages like Python for automation tasks.
Familiarity with cloud services and backend integration.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, please note we do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to any advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

What’s in it for you?

Here is what you can expect

Family Care Leave
- We offer enhanced paid leave options for those important times.

Insurances
– All colleagues are covered by our life and disability insurance which provides protection and peace of mind.

Wellbeing
- We want our people to feel well and thrive. We offer resources and benefits to nurture physical and mental wellbeing along with opportunities to build community and inspire creativity.

Colleague Discount
– We know you'll love to build, so from day 1 you will qualify for our generous colleague discount.

Bonus
- We do our best work to succeed together. When goals are reached and if eligible, you'll be rewarded through our bonus scheme.

Workplace
- When you join the team you'll be assigned a primary workplace location i.e. one of our Offices, stores or factories. Our hybrid work policy means an average of 3 days per week in the office. The hiring team will discuss the policy and role eligibility with you during the recruitment process.

Children are our role models. Their curiosity, creativity and imagination inspire everything we do. We strive to create a diverse, dynamic and inclusive culture of play at the LEGO Group, where everyone feels safe, valued and they belong.

The LEGO Group is highly committed to equal employment opportunity and equal pay and seeks to encourage applicants from all backgrounds (eg. sex, gender identity or expression, race/ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, age and religion) to apply for roles in our team.

The LEGO Group is fully committed to Children’s Rights and Child Wellbeing across the globe. Candidates offered positions with high engagement with children are required to take part in Child Safeguarding Background Screening, as a condition of the offer.

Thank you for sharing our global commitment to Children’s Rights.

Just imagine building your dream career.

Then make it real.

Join the LEGO® team today.
